Agent Name: PythonDebugging_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent completely hallucinated the nature of the problem. The real-world task was to find a specific GFF3 file link for beluga whales, but the agent (following a flawed "manager" plan included in the prompt) incorrectly assumed the task was to debug a code execution failure with an "unknown language unknown" error. Consequently, the agent spent the entire conversation generating irrelevant Python debugging scripts instead of searching for or retrieving the requested biological data link.
